name: Oscarsborg festning
coordSource: Lovdata FOR-2014-04-09-1986 inventory 1 – Hovedfortet; Forsvarsbygg Oscarsborg landsverneplan; OpenStreetMap relation 972050 – Hovedfortet; Riksantikvaren Oscarsborg protection scope
coordChangeReason: The rounded legacy point is moved approximately 287.5 metres south to the deterministic centroid of the named Hovedfortet multipolygon on Søndre Kaholmen. The gameplay radius increases from 360 to 520 metres so the central fort, Hovedbatteriet and the Torpedobatteriet secondary anchor remain inside one Kaholmene visitor-core record without absorbing remote mainland batteries.
coordNote: Lovdata identifies Hovedfortet as protected inventory 1, built 1849–1856, and Forsvarsbygg describes Søndre Kaholmen as the central and oldest part of Oscarsborg. OpenStreetMap relation 972050 is a named Hovedfortet multipolygon tagged historic=fort and building=yes. Its outer and inner rings were materialized from a read-only source artifact and yield the deterministic centroid 59.67346966441094, 10.607055536295166. Hovedbatteriet way 528047559 lies approximately 102.2 metres away. The protected Torpedobatteriet, inventory 1018, is represented by a semantic secondary anchor approximately 482.7 metres north, physically cross-checked by its 1901 door, underground tunnel, sight towers, workshop and torpedo-warhead storage cluster. The 520-metre radius represents the key Kaholmene visitor and 9 April core; it is not the legal protection landscape, cadastral boundary, firing sector, underwater geometry or a claim that remote batteries such as Kopås, Seiersten, Heer, Nesset or Håøya are inside the canonical place circle.

accessContext.publicAccess: Oscarsborg is a public fortress destination reached by ferry. Outdoor access, museum and building access, guided areas, events and transport conditions can differ by season and operation; current signs and operator information take precedence.
limitations: Do not enter closed bunkers, tunnels, magazines, technical rooms, fenced areas or protected interiors without explicit permission.
Respect ferry operations, quays, museum rules, conservation barriers, steep terrain and water-edge hazards.
The gameplay radius is not the legal protection polygon, property boundary, military firing sector, underwater installation geometry or access guarantee.

desc: Festningen i Drøbaksundet som senket den tyske krysseren Blücher 9. april 1940. Oscarsborg er et nasjonalt krigsminne der geografi, beslutning og politisk historie møtes.
popupDesc: Oscarsborg festning er et av Norges sterkeste krigshistoriske steder. Da tyske styrker kom inn Oslofjorden natt til 9. april 1940, åpnet festningen ild og senket Blücher. Dette forsinket invasjonen mot hovedstaden og ga konge, regjering og Storting tid til å komme seg unna. Stedet er derfor ikke bare en festning, men et punkt der en militær handling fikk store politiske konsekvenser.

quiz_profile.notes: Skal spørres som beslutnings- og konsekvenssted i krigshistorien. Canonical følger Hovedfortet på Søndre Kaholmen, mens Hovedbatteriet og Torpedobatteriet er eksplisitte sekundærankre for 9. april-funksjonene.
